articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.snippet: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: The $2.85B Binance hackers lost shows why the UK needs stablecoin freeze rules
articles.snippet: The Binance hack proved stablecoin freezes work. Now the UK should make clear freeze rules a condition of listing coins.
